definitions.explanation: A character or part played by an actor in a performance, film, or play.
A function, responsibility, or official position assigned to someone in a group or organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{役|やく}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{演|えん}じている→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: In this film, I took on the role of a father for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{司会|しかい}→司会：00364_shikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}された。
examples.english: I was assigned the role of emcee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やらない→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いけない。
examples.english: Someone has to take on the role of leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{書記|しょき}→書記：13055_shoki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I often take on the role of note-taker at meetings.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is common in theater, film, and television contexts. Sense 2 extends to any assigned function within a group. Often combined with other words to form compounds: ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧ (lead role), ⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧ (supporting role), ⟦{悪役|あくやく}→悪役：12675_akuyaku⟧ (villain role), {適役|てきやく} (well-suited role).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{役|やく}を{演|えん}じる→役を演じる：24402_yakuwoenjiru⟧: to play a role
- {役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧: to take on a role
- ⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧: to be useful
- {役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}される: to be assigned a role
